#### Truly global, always local

CVC's network comprises 29 offices globally, making it one of the most geographically diverse and longest-established networks of any private equity or credit investor worldwide.

- [Our Network](https://www.cvc.com/about/our-network/)

## One platform, seven strategies

CVC has seven complementary strategies across private equity, secondaries, credit and infrastructure through which we invest on behalf of pension funds and other leading institutions.
